note: Core measurement methods that feed into each other: scope technique for SI and power measurements
SI measurement connects to EMC testing and PCB impedance design
Manufacturing test chain: JTAG, functional test, and failure analysis form the production test and debug flow
Reliability testing: ESS precipitates defects found by thermal measurement and analyzed by FA
Measurement quality: calibration supports both functional test limits and oscilloscope measurement accuracy
EMC pre-compliance connects to power supply characterization (conducted emissions source) and EMC design
Thermal measurement validates thermal design for both PCB and power system designs
Failure analysis feeds back into FMEA and stress screening effectiveness
SI measurement validates high-speed link budgets and stackup designs
DFM drives testability which drives functional test and JTAG strategy
Power supply characterization validates converter design and loop compensation
Calibration methodology applies to both thermal and power integrity measurement accuracy
